messages:
kevin_ops: Postmortem follow-up for the cache eviction incident. We need firm owners + dates to convert findings into tests, eval promptsets, a load/chaos drill, and CI gating. Sketch below — please confirm.

anya: I can own deterministic regression cases. Plan: two suites - `eviction_repro` (fail reproducer cases) and `cache_warm_smoke` (pre-deploy warm checks). PR with tests + README by 04/12. Tests will live under tests/cache_repro/.

leo_m: I'll take the CI integration and gating. Adding a pipeline `cache-regress` that runs on merge + nightly. Config PR by 04/14. Local quick run: ``pytest tests/cache_repro -k eviction -q``.

samir: I'll assemble the promptsets and eval harness (EVAL-333). Will include long-prefix chains, repeat-token loops, truncated-stream streaming cases, and expected completions. Also adding seq-hallucination-rate and kv_miss_rate metrics. Promptset PR by 04/11, initial eval run by 04/13.

dina_oncall: I'll own the load scenario and the chaos drill in staging. Plan: k6 stress at 2x normal burst then a one-node GPU worker kill while monitoring KV miss ratio and p95/p99 tails. k6 example: ``k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m scripts/cache_spike.js``. Proposed staging drill: 04/15 09:00-10:30 PT. I'll post the checklist/runbook in #eng-oncall.

qa-jen: I'll own gating. Add rules to block merges if `cache-regress` fails and ensure flaky detection. Need Samir's golden outputs for the promptsets. I'll also add a brief local repro doc for SRE/devs by 04/13.

incident-bot: created TASK-PLAT-901: "cache eviction regression + evals" assigned to anya.

kevin_ops: Good. Quick owners summary for the follow-up ticket PM-FU-5002: anya -> regression tests (TASK-PLAT-901), samir -> eval promptsets/metrics (EVAL-333), leo_m -> CI/gating, dina_oncall -> load & chaos (TASK-OPS-600), qa-jen -> CI gating + golden outputs. Can everyone confirm ETAs?

anya: Confirmed. PR by 04/12, will include a README with run commands and expected results.

samir: Confirmed. Promptset + golden outputs PR by 04/11; eval run 04/13. I'll include fuzzy-match thresholds for sequence scoring.

leo_m: Confirmed. Config PR 04/14; nightly enable 04/18. Also adding a small deploy smoke: ``curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"warm_cache_seed"}'`` as part of pre-deploy checks.

anya: I'll wire `cache_warm_smoke` to use that curl for the smoke test and add it to pre-deploy.

qa-jen: :thumbsup: I'll monitor flakiness after the first few runs and loop in infra if we hit resource contention on k6.

incident-bot: linked TASK-PLAT-901 -> PM-FU-5002, EVAL-333, TASK-OPS-600.

kevin_ops: I'll own PM-FU-5002 and run weekly check-ins until tasks are closed. Please add PR links to the ticket as you open them. Closing this thread if no more blockers.
